shellCommands.command: ls /home/sandbox/workspace && cat /home/sandbox/workspace/package.json
find /home/sandbox/workspace/src -type f | head -50; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/index.html /home/sandbox/workspace/vite.config.ts /home/sandbox/workspace/tsconfig.json
cat /home/sandbox/workspace/src/App.tsx /home/sandbox/workspace/src/main.tsx
npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons @tanstack/react-table 2>&1 | tail -20
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -30; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/table versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -20
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 peerDependencies --json; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/table@1.25.0 peerDependencies --json; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/table@1.25.0 dependencies --json
npm view @gravity-ui/icons version; npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/table@1.25.0 @gravity-ui/icons@^2 @dnd-kit/core@^6 @dnd-kit/sortable@^9 @gravity-ui/i18n lodash 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls navigation table; echo ===; ls navigation/dist 2>/dev/null | head; ls table/dist 2>/dev/null | head; echo ===; ls navigation/docs table/docs navigation/dist/docs table/dist/docs 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls navigation/build table/build | head -40; echo ===; wc -l navigation/README.md table/README.md
ls navigation/build/docs table/build/docs
grep -n -i -C 3 "styles" navigation/README.md table/README.md | head -60

find navigation/build table/build -maxdepth 2 -name "*.css" | head; echo ===; grep -rn "import.*css" table/build/esm/index.js navigation/build/esm/index.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo ===; grep -n '"exports"' -A 30 table/package.json | head -40
grep -rln "\.css" table/build/esm | head -3; grep -rln "\.css" navigation/build/esm | head -3; grep -n "css" table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -o "House\|Persons\|Person\b\|ShoppingCart\|Gear\|ListCheck\|Boxes\|FileRouble\|Receipt" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head
ls table/build/docs/hooks table/build/docs/components; echo ===; cat table/build/docs/hooks/useTable.md 2>/dev/null | head -80

grep -rn "useRowSelectionFixedHandler" table/build/esm/index.d.ts table/build/esm/hooks/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ===; cat table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts 2>/dev/null; find table/build/esm -name "*RowSelectionFixed*"

cat table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.d.ts; echo ===TABLE===; sed -n 1,80p table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; echo ===BASETABLE-PROPS===; grep -n "getGroupTitle\|withNestingStyles\|TreeExpandableCell" -r table/build/esm/components --include=*.d.ts | head

cat table/build/esm/constants/selectionColumn.d.ts table/build/esm/constants/dragHandleColumn.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ===; cat table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find table/build/esm -name "ColumnReorderingProvider*" ; echo ===; grep -n "enableColumnReordering" -r table/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5
sed -n 1,60p table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts; echo ===; grep -n "interface ColumnReorderingProviderProps" -A 25 table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts

cat table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.d.ts table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts; echo ===LABEL===; grep -n "theme" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/types.d.ts | head

grep -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow\|subRows" table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head; echo ===; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/ 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "LabelTheme\|theme?" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
grep -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow" -B2 -A6 table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -30
grep -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow\|getGroupTitle\|subRows" table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js | head; grep -rn "getIsGroupHeaderRow" table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js | head
cat table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js table/build/esm/components/TreeExpandableCell/TreeExpandableCell.js

grep -n "onReorder\|setColumnOrder" table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.js table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/hooks/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -15
grep -rn "content\|height" navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -20; echo ===; grep -n "renderContent" navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head

cat navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ===; grep -n "AsideHeaderItem\|FooterItem" navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; echo ===; grep -n "icon\b\|text\|href\|onClick" navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "LogoProps" navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "interface LogoProps" -A 15 navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo ===; grep -n "AsideHeaderItem\|MenuItem" navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head; echo ===; grep -n "export" navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -20
grep -rn "AsideHeaderItem" navigation/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "AsideHeaderProps" -A 8 navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm 2>/dev/null || cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons; ls | grep -i "^boxes\|^gear\|^house\|^persons\|^shoppingcart\|^receipt" | head; echo ===; ls; echo ===; grep -n "ColumnDef\|types/base" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | head -30
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -12
